init_hook: if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then export ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk; else export ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android; fi
rustup default stable >/dev/null 2>&1 || rustup toolchain install stable

gen_bindings: cd noir_spartan && cargo run --bin uniffi-bindgen generate --no-format --library ./target/release/libnoir_spartan.$([ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && echo dylib || echo so) --language kotlin --out-dir ../app/src/main/java/com/example/zkp_android_spartan/
ndk_build: cd noir_spartan && cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a $([ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] && echo '-t x86_64') -o ../app/src/main/jniLibs build --release
launch_app: $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb shell pm path com.example.zkp_android_spartan >/dev/null 2>&1 || $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
logcat: PID=$($ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb shell pidof -s com.example.zkp_android_spartan); if [ -n "$PID" ]; then $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb logcat --pid=$PID "$@"; else echo 'App not running, showing full logcat' >&2; $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb logcat "$@"; fi
